rundown: Hurricanes beat Kraken 4-1 at Veikkaus Arena in Helsinki in front of 12,523. Hurricanes led 3-0 after two periods and never looked back. The 1st period decided it: Hurricanes won it 2-0.
5 goals in all. Hurricanes's last: Sebastian Aho Goal Slap Shot, assists: K'Andre Miller (7), Andrei Svechnikov (10), 3rd period 11:41.
Leading the way — Hurricanes: Sebastian Aho 2 goals, 2 pts; K'Andre Miller 2 ast. Kraken: Frederick Gaudreau 1 goal, 1 pts; Mackie Samoskevich 1 ast.
Where Hurricanes won it: they outshot them 30-13 and scored 1 on the power play to 0.
Against the closing line (DraftKings): Hurricanes closed as 1.5-goal favorites and covered by 1.5; the total closed at 6.5 and they combined for 5, under by 1.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 12, 11:57 AM ET. It had Hurricanes 57% and Kraken 43%, projecting Hurricanes 3.4 – Kraken 3 (6.5 total, Hurricanes by 0.4).

Final: Hurricanes 4 – Kraken 1. Right winner: it had Hurricanes at 57%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Hurricanes came in with a 11% above average attack and a 7% stingier than average defense (14-3-2, 4.1 scored and 2.4 allowed a game over 19 games), worth about 77 and 76 games of evidence. Projected to score 3.4, they scored 4 (+0.6 goals, 17% over); projected to allow 3, they allowed 1 (−2 goals, 67% under).

Kraken came in with a league-average attack and a 3% leakier than average defense (9-6-1, 3.6 scored and 3.6 allowed a game over 16 games), worth about 75 and 75 games of evidence. Projected to score 3, they scored 1 (−2 goals, 67% under); projected to allow 3.4, they allowed 4 (+0.6 goals, 17% over).

The bigger miss was Kraken's scoring (-2 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 5 against 6.5 projected (-1.5), about the 28th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±2.5).

Margin: Hurricanes by 3 against Hurricanes by 0.4 projected, about the 15th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±2.5).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
SEA ML (+245) at +245: the algo gave it 30% vs 28% fair (+2.1 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 28%). CAR ML (-305) at -305: the algo gave it 70% vs 72% fair (-2.1 pts) — won (+0.3u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 72%). SEA +1.5 (+102) at +102: the algo gave it 51% vs 47% fair (+3.2 pts), THE PICK — lost (-1u); same number as the close. CAR -1.5 (-122) at -122: the algo gave it 49% vs 53% fair (-3.2 pts) — won (+0.8u); same number as the close. OVER 6.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (-0.2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 6.5 (-108) at -108: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0.2 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 77% of bets on Hurricanes, 90% of the money — Hurricanes covered; total: 80% of bets on the over, 84% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 97% of bets on Hurricanes, 98% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Hurricanes, who won and covered.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.760 of the raw projection. It counts toward NHL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 54 graded NHL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.956 and gives home teams 0 goals. Team corrections so far: Hurricanes attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (3 games); Kraken attack ×0.960, defense ×0.987 (3 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 2.6 goals), the pick lost (-1u).
